title: Magnolia Table With Joanna Gaines
description: Friend and chef Katie Button teaches Joanna how to make some of her favorite Spanish dishes like flamenquines, grandma's olives, simple sautéed greens and a brandied pumpkin cheesecake.

title: Magnolia Table With Joanna Gaines
description: Joanna welcomes special guest Emma Lovewell into the kitchen to make traditional Asian dishes, including japchae, yaki gyoza and egg drop soup; as a homage to Jo's favorite childhood cookie, they bake a delicious almond butter cake for dessert.

title: Magnolia Table With Joanna Gaines
description: Joanna shares her all-time favorite recipes and the family stories that accompany them, including chicken cordon bleu, Gruyère potato casserole, arugula and dried cherry salad and peanut butter pie with chocolate crust.

title: Magnolia Table: At the Farm
description: Joanna bakes her kids' favorite treats like cinnamon pecan Bundt cake and her signature banana bread; she also shares a look at her rose garden and flower preservation techniques.

title: Magnolia Table: At the Farm
description: Joanna shares her three go-to cookie recipes, which are chocolate chip, frosted sugar cookie sandwich and the Silo cookie; she also reminisces about her childhood, sharing photos, as well as her personal favorite ways to enjoy each cookie.

title: Magnolia Table: At the Farm
description: The flowers in Joanna's annual garden are in full bloom; she demonstrates how to make two year-round favorites, her Brown Butter Pumpkin Chocolate Chip Bread and a savory Bacon Cheddar Quiche.

title: Magnolia Table: At the Farm
description: Joanna demonstrates how to bake elevated Blueberry Muffins with Streusel Topping and shares a recipe, Jo's Buttermilk Biscuits; she also reminisces about her mom's cooking and makes a dried floral arrangement in a glass cloche.

title: Magnolia Table: At the Farm
description: At the farm, Joanna bakes her savory Prize Pig biscuit and Maple Pecan Baked Oatmeal; she also visits her baby ducks; a birthday gift from Chip.

title: Magnolia Table: At the Farm
description: Joanna Gaines shares her favorite recipes from her family's farm.

title: Magnolia Table With Joanna Gaines
description: Joanna shares Grandpa Stevens' classic Lebanese dish, fatayer, served with a Lebanese salad, hummus and baklava for dessert; after finishing up, Joanna surprises her dad with the leftovers of his favorite meal.
